content.text:
**Finding submitted: deviation (INDEMN, critical).**

What I found:

- **§ 8.1 (IBM indemnity)** covers only third-party IP infringement claims relating to Materials/Base Components, with the usual exclusions (Customer-provided items, modifications, combinations, non-IBM components) and procure/modify/replace/credit remedies capped at 12 months' charges, closing with "This is IBM's entire obligation to Customer with regard to any claim of infringement." That satisfies the fallback for IP only.
- **Missing preferred heads:** no IBM indemnity for its breach of applicable law, for IBM-caused unauthorised access to or disclosure of our data, or for its gross negligence/wilful misconduct — and § 9.1(c)(1)–(2) expressly excludes third-party claims and data loss falling outside § 8.1, so there is no residual recovery route.
- **§ 8.2(a)(3) (our indemnity)** is far broader than the playbook permits: any Services Recipient claim "related, directly or indirectly, to the Services" — in substance a one-way Customer indemnity for IBM's own Services (a walk-away item, only partly mitigated by the § 8.2(c) relief for IBM's misconduct).

Redline (validated, ok:true):

1. New paragraph inserted at the end of § 8.1 adding IBM's defence/indemnity for (i) breach of applicable law, (ii) IBM-caused unauthorised access to or disclosure of our Content/data, and (iii) gross negligence or wilful misconduct — placed inside § 8.1 deliberately so it inherits the uncapped treatment in § 9.1(a) and the existing notice/control/cooperation procedure, with the infringement-only remedies limitation expressly confined to IP claims.
2. § 8.2(a)(3) narrowed to Services Recipient claims arising out of our breach of applicable law or of the Agreement.

Fallback offered in the comment: the added IBM heads can be subject to a 3× annual charges super-cap.
